records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: let not boast [the] wise in his wisdom, and let not boast the mighty in his might; let not boast [the] rich in his riches.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Let not the wise boast in {{gender:their|his}} wisdom, and let not the mighty boast in {{gender:their|his}} might; let not the rich boast in {{gender:their|his}} riches.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: The wise must not boast about {{gender:their|his}} wisdom, the strong must not boast about {{gender:their|his}} strength, and the rich must not boast about {{gender:their|his}} wealth.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Wise people should not brag about how wise they are. Strong people should not brag about how strong they are. Rich people should not brag about how rich they are.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No se gloríe el sabio en su sabiduría, ni se gloríe el valiente en su valentía; no se gloríe el rico en sus riquezas.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Que el sabio no se jacte de su sabiduría, que el fuerte no se jacte de su fuerza, y que el rico no se jacte de su riqueza.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Los sabios no deben presumir de lo sabios que son. Los fuertes no deben presumir de lo fuertes que son. Los ricos no deben presumir de lo ricos que son.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Que le sage ne se vante pas de sa sagesse, et que le fort ne se vante pas de sa force ; que le riche ne se vante pas de sa richesse.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Que le sage ne se vante pas de sa sagesse, que le fort ne se vante pas de sa force, et que le riche ne se vante pas de sa richesse.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Les gens sages ne doivent pas se vanter d’être sages. Les gens forts ne doivent pas se vanter d’être forts. Les gens riches ne doivent pas se vanter d’être riches.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Mwenye hekima asijisifu kwa hekima yake, wala mwenye nguvu asijisifu kwa nguvu zake; tajiri asijisifu kwa utajiri wake.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Mwenye hekima asijivune kwa hekima yake, mwenye nguvu asijivune kwa nguvu zake, wala tajiri asijivune kwa mali yake.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Watu wenye hekima wasijigambe kwa jinsi walivyo na hekima. Watu wenye nguvu wasijigambe kwa jinsi walivyo na nguvu. Matajiri wasijigambe kwa jinsi walivyo matajiri.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Người khôn ngoan chớ khoe sự khôn ngoan mình, người mạnh sức chớ khoe sức mạnh mình, người giàu có chớ khoe sự giàu có mình.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Người khôn ngoan đừng khoe khoang về sự khôn ngoan của mình, người mạnh mẽ đừng khoe khoang về sức mạnh của mình, người giàu có đừng khoe khoang về của cải của mình.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Người khôn ngoan đừng khoe mình khôn ngoan. Người mạnh mẽ đừng khoe mình mạnh mẽ. Người giàu có đừng khoe mình giàu có.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 지혜로운 자는 자기 지혜를 자랑하지 말고, 용사는 자기 힘을 자랑하지 말고, 부자는 자기 부를 자랑하지 마라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 지혜로운 사람은 자기 지혜를 자랑하지 말고, 강한 사람은 자기 힘을 자랑하지 말고, 부유한 사람은 자기 재산을 자랑하지 마라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 지혜로운 사람은 자기가 지혜롭다고 뽐내지 마라. 힘센 사람은 자기가 힘세다고 뽐내지 마라. 부자는 자기가 부자라고 뽐내지 마라.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Que o sábio não se glorie na sua sabedoria, e que o valente não se glorie na sua valentia; que o rico não se glorie na sua riqueza.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: O sábio não deve se orgulhar da sua sabedoria, o forte não deve se orgulhar da sua força, e o rico não deve se orgulhar da sua riqueza.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Quem é sábio não deve se gabar da sua sabedoria. Quem é forte não deve se gabar da sua força. Quem é rico não deve se gabar da sua riqueza.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ጠቢብ በጥበቡ አይመካ፤ ኃያልም በኃይሉ አይመካ፤ ባለ ጠጋም በብልጽግናው አይመካ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ጠቢብ በጥበቡ አይመካ፤ ብርቱም በብርታቱ አይመካ፤ ሀብታምም በሀብቱ አይመካ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ጠቢባን በጥበባቸው አይመኩ። ብርቱ ሰዎች በብርታታቸው አይመኩ። ሀብታሞችም በሀብታቸው አይመኩ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: बुद्धिमान अपनी बुद्धि पर गर्व न करे, और बलवान अपने बल पर गर्व न करे; धनी अपने धन पर गर्व न करे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: बुद्धिमान अपनी बुद्धि पर गर्व न करे, बलवान अपनी शक्ति पर गर्व न करे, और धनी अपनी दौलत पर गर्व न करे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: बुद्धिमान लोग अपनी बुद्धि पर गर्व न करें। बलवान लोग अपनी ताक़त पर गर्व न करें। धनी लोग अपने धन पर गर्व न करें।

ru.L: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Пусть не хвалится мудрый своей мудростью, и пусть не хвалится сильный своей силой; пусть не хвалится богатый своим богатством.
ru.B: Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Мудрый пусть не хвалится своей мудростью, сильный пусть не хвалится своей силой, и богатый пусть не хвалится своим богатством.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Мудрые люди не должны хвалиться своей мудростью. Сильные люди не должны хвалиться своей силой. Богатые люди не должны хвалиться своим богатством.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。知恵ある者は自分の知恵を誇るな。力ある者は自分の力を誇るな。富める者は自分の富を誇るな。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。知恵ある者は、自分の知恵を誇ってはならない。力ある者は、自分の力を誇ってはならない。富める者は、自分の富を誇ってはならない。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。知恵のある人は、自分の知恵を自慢してはいけない。力の強い人は、自分の強さを自慢してはいけない。お金持ちは、自分の富を自慢してはいけない。

decisions.choice: boast: take pride in, rely on as one's glory
decisions.reason: The verb means to praise oneself, to make something one's pride and confidence. What a person boasts in is what they trust to make them secure and important.

decisions.choice: the wise, the mighty, the rich: the things a people trusted
decisions.reason: Wisdom, military strength and wealth were the marks of a successful nation and its leaders. Jeremiah has already shown the wise with no word from the LORD (8:8-9; verse 11 here), and the strong and rich will not be saved by what they have (5:27-28).

decisions.choice: a new saying in prose
decisions.reason: From here to the end of the chapter the text is prose, not poetry. The saying of verses 22-23 answers the question of verse 11: true wisdom is to know the LORD.

decisions.choice: the strong ... strength; wealth / brag
decisions.reason: Balanced says "strong" and "strength" for the warrior's might and "wealth" for riches. Readable says "brag about how wise they are", which says the same thing in plain words.

decisions.choice: "su sabiduría", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "su" serves for men and women alike, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: "le sage ... sa sagesse", no gender span
decisions.reason: French "sa" agrees with the thing possessed, not with the owner, so "sa sagesse" says nothing about whether the wise one is a man or a woman; the English gender spans have no French counterpart.

decisions.choice: gloriar-se (L); orgulhar-se (B); gabar-se (R)
decisions.reason: As the New Testament sets the verb that Paul takes from this passage (docs/portuguese-style.md section 6): "gloriar-se" at Literal, "orgulhar-se" at Balanced, and at Readable "gabar-se", where the English Readable says "brag". The verse is well known in Portuguese in wording this translation does not copy; Literal says "Que ... não se glorie" and "o valente ... na sua valentia".

decisions.choice: boast "መመካት" (ይመካ) at every level
decisions.reason: The verb of 1 Corinthians 1:31 and 2 Corinthians 10:17 in the Amharic New Testament, which quote the next verse, so that the three boasts here and the one boast there read as one saying.

decisions.choice: "गर्व करें" at Readable too
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "गर्व करना" for boasting, the verb of 1 Corinthians 1:31 and 2 Corinthians 10:17, so that the next verse, which Paul quotes, uses the same word as these lines.

decisions.choice: "хвалиться" at every level
decisions.reason: The verb is the one 1 Corinthians 1:31 and 2 Corinthians 10:17 use when Paul quotes the next verse, so Readable keeps "хвалиться" too.

decisions.choice: hithallel "誇る" (L, B), "自慢する" (R, the English R "brag"); the jussives are "〜するな" (L), "〜してはならない" (B), "〜してはいけない" (R), the oracle forms; "自分の" with no gender span for {{gender:their|his}}.
decisions.reason: PROPHETIC CONVENTIONS for prohibitions; style guide 7a.

source.text: כִּ֣י אִם־בְּזֹ֞את יִתְהַלֵּ֣ל הַמִּתְהַלֵּ֗ל הַשְׂכֵּל֮ וְיָדֹ֣עַ אוֹתִי֒ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עֹ֥שֶׂה חֶ֛סֶד מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה בָּאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־בְאֵ֥לֶּה חָפַ֖צְתִּי נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: But rather in this let boast the [one] boasting: having insight and knowing me, that I [am] Yahweh doing loyal love, justice and righteousness in the earth; for in these I delight, declares Yahweh.

en.L: But let the one who boasts boast in this: understanding and knowing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who does loyal love, justice and righteousness in the earth; for in these I delight, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Instead, whoever boasts should boast of this: that they understand and know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who acts with loyal love, justice and righteousness on the earth. For these are what I delight in, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Instead, anyone who wants to brag should brag about this: that they understand {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I act with faithful love, justice and righteousness on the earth. These are the things that please {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Mas el que se gloríe, gloríese en esto: en entender{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} y conocer{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que hago amor leal, derecho y justicia en la tierra; porque en estas cosas me complazco, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Más bien, quien se gloríe, que se gloríe en esto: en que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} entiende y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conoce, en que sabe que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que actúo con amor fiel, derecho y justicia en la tierra. Porque en esto me complazco, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Al contrario, el que quiera presumir, que presuma de esto: de que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} entiende y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conoce. De que sabe que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Yo actúo con amor fiel, justicia y rectitud en la tierra. Estas son las cosas que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agradan, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Mais que celui qui se vante se vante de ceci : d’avoir de l’intelligence et de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaître, de savoir que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui exerce l’amour loyal, le droit et la justice sur la terre ; car c’est en cela que je prends plaisir, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Que celui qui se vante se vante plutôt de ceci : de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} comprendre et de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaître, de savoir que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui agit avec amour fidèle, droit et justice sur la terre. Car c’est en cela que je prends plaisir, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Au contraire, que celui qui veut se vanter se vante de ceci : de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} comprendre et de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaître. Qu’il sache que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. J’agis avec amour fidèle, avec droit et justice sur la terre. Ce sont ces choses-là qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} plaisent, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Bali yeye ajisifuye na ajisifu kwa hili: kwamba ana ufahamu na kunijua {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, ya kuwa mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitendaye upendo usiokoma, hukumu na haki duniani; kwa maana katika hayo napendezwa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Badala yake, anayetaka kujivuna na ajivune kwa hili: kwamba ananielewa na kunijua {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, ya kuwa mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninayetenda kwa upendo usiokoma, kwa haki na kwa uadilifu duniani. Kwa maana mambo hayo ndiyo ninayoyapenda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Badala yake, mtu yeyote anayetaka kujigamba na ajigambe kwa hili: kwamba ananielewa na kunijua. Anajua kwamba mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ninatenda kwa upendo usiokoma, kwa haki na kwa uadilifu duniani. Hayo ndiyo mambo yanayonipendeza, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Nhưng ai khoe mình, hãy khoe về điều này: là hiểu biết và biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng làm điều yêu thương thành tín, công bình và công chính trên đất; vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ưa thích những điều ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Trái lại, ai khoe mình thì hãy khoe về điều này: là người ấy hiểu biết và biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng hành động với tình yêu thương thành tín, công bình và công chính trên đất. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ưa thích những điều ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Thay vào đó, ai muốn khoe thì hãy khoe về điều này: là họ hiểu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Họ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ta hành động với tình thương không hề thay đổi, với công lý và sự công chính trên đất. Đó là những điều làm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vui lòng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 자랑하는 자는 이것을 자랑하여라. 나를 깨닫고 아는 것, 곧 내가 땅에서 한결같은 사랑과 정의와 의를 행하는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}라는 것을 [자랑하여라]. 내가 이런 것들을 기뻐하기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 자랑하려는 사람은 이것을 자랑하여라. 나를 깨닫고 아는 것, 곧 내가 땅 위에서 한결같은 사랑과 정의와 의를 베푸는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}라는 것을 자랑하여라. 나는 이런 일들을 기뻐한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 뽐내고 싶은 사람은 이것을 뽐내라. 나를 깨닫고 나를 아는 것을 뽐내라. 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}라는 것을 아는 것을 뽐내라. 나는 땅 위에서 변함없는 사랑과 정의와 옳은 일을 행한다. 이런 것들이 나를 기쁘게 한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Mas quem se gloria, que se glorie nisto: em ter entendimento e conhecer a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que pratico amor leal, justiça e retidão na terra; pois nestas coisas tenho prazer, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Em vez disso, quem quiser se orgulhar, que se orgulhe disto: de entender e {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhecer, de saber que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que ajo com amor leal, justiça e retidão na terra. Pois é nisso que tenho prazer, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Em vez disso, quem quiser se orgulhar, que se orgulhe disto: de entender quem eu sou e de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhecer. Que saiba que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Eu ajo com amor fiel, com justiça e com retidão na terra. São essas as coisas que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agradam, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: ነገር ግን የሚመካ በዚህ ይመካ፤ እኔን በማስተዋሉና በማወቁ፣ በምድር ላይ ጽኑ ፍቅርን፣ ፍርድንና ጽድቅን የማደርግ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ፤ በእነዚህ ደስ ይለኛልና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: ይልቁንም የሚመካ ሁሉ በዚህ ይመካ፤ እኔን በማስተዋሉና በማወቁ፣ በምድር ላይ በጽኑ ፍቅር፣ በፍትሕና በጽድቅ የምሠራ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መሆኔን በማወቁ። ደስ የሚያሰኙኝ እነዚህ ናቸውና፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ይልቁንም መመካት የሚፈልግ ማንም ሰው በዚህ ይመካ፤ እኔን በማስተዋሉና እኔን በማወቁ። እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መሆኔን ያውቃል። በምድር ላይ በጽኑ ፍቅር፣ በፍትሕና በጽድቅ እሠራለሁ። ደስ የሚያሰኙኝ እነዚህ ነገሮች ናቸው፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: पर जो गर्व करे, वह इस बात पर गर्व करे: कि वह समझता है और मुझे जानता है, कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ, जो पृथ्वी पर अटल प्रेम, न्याय और धार्मिकता के काम करता है; क्योंकि मैं इन्हीं से प्रसन्न रहता हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: बल्कि जो गर्व करे, वह इस विषय में गर्व करे: कि वह मुझे समझता और जानता है, कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ, जो पृथ्वी पर अटल प्रेम, न्याय और धार्मिकता से काम करता है। क्योंकि इन्हीं बातों से मैं प्रसन्न होता हूँ, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: बल्कि जो कोई गर्व करना चाहे, वह इस बात के विषय में गर्व करे: कि वह मुझे समझता है और मुझे जानता है। वह जानता है कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ। मैं पृथ्वी पर अटल प्रेम, न्याय और धार्मिकता से काम करता हूँ। इन्हीं बातों से मुझे ख़ुशी होती है, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: Но хвалящийся пусть хвалится этим: тем, что разумеет и знает {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, творящий неизменную любовь, правосудие и праведность на земле; потому что в этом {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} нахожу радость, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Вместо этого кто хвалится, пусть хвалится тем, что понимает и знает {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, знает, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, который поступает с неизменной любовью, справедливо и праведно на земле. Ведь именно это {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} по душе, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Вместо этого кто хочет хвалиться, пусть хвалится тем, что понимает {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} и знает {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. Пусть знает, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. Я поступаю с неизменной любовью, справедливо и праведно на земле. Именно это {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} приятно, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: むしろ、誇る者は、このことを誇れ。悟りを得て、わたしを知っていること、わたしが地に誠実と公正と正義を行う{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを。まことに、わたしはこれらを喜ぶ。――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――
ja.B: むしろ、誇る者は、このことを誇りなさい。わたしを悟り、わたしを知っていること、わたしが地の上で変わらぬいつくしみと公正と正義を行う{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを。わたしはこれらのことを喜ぶ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: むしろ、誇りたい人は、このことを誇りなさい。わたしを理解し、わたしを知っていることを。わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知っていることを。わたしは、地上で、変わらない愛と、公正と、正義を行う。わたしはこういうことを喜ぶ、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

decisions.choice: let the one who boasts boast in this: quoted by Paul
decisions.reason: Paul sums up this verse as "The one who boasts must boast in the Lord" (1 Corinthians 1:31; 2 Corinthians 10:17), setting God's wisdom in Christ against human wisdom, strength and status, as Jeremiah sets knowing the LORD against wisdom, might and riches.

decisions.choice: understanding and knowing me: knowing the LORD for who he is
decisions.reason: The two verbs say "having insight and knowing", without naming a person or a time. To "know" the LORD is to acknowledge him and live in his ways; Jeremiah later says that to do justice for the poor "is to know me" (22:16). It answers verses 2 and 5, where the people refuse to know him.

decisions.choice: loyal love, justice and righteousness: what the LORD does and loves
decisions.reason: Loyal love (*hesed*) is faithful, generous love kept within a covenant. Justice is setting things right, especially for the weak; righteousness is doing what is right by others. The LORD does these "in the earth", among people, and delights in them, so those who know him will do them too (22:3, 15-16).

decisions.choice: loyal love / faithful love
decisions.reason: *Hesed* is "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced and "faithful love" at Readable, as in Isaiah. Balanced and Readable put "understanding and knowing me" as "that they understand and know me", and Readable breaks the sentence into short sentences.

decisions.choice: "quien se gloríe, que se gloríe en esto"
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets it, the key words Paul quotes in 1 Corinthians 1:31, so the reader can hear the quotation; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: ajisifuye na ajisifu (Literal); ajivune (Balanced); ajigambe (Readable)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line (1 Corinthians 1:31; 2 Corinthians 10:17); Literal keeps the word "kujisifu" so the quotation can be recognized.

decisions.choice: "que celui qui se vante se vante de ceci"
decisions.reason: "Se vanter" is the verb of the French 1 Corinthians 1:31, which quotes this verse, so the reader can recognize it.

decisions.choice: "que celui qui veut se vanter ... qu’il sache"
decisions.reason: French keeps "celui qui ... il", which is already generic, where the English Readable uses "they".

decisions.choice: "ai khoe mình, hãy khoe về điều này"
decisions.reason: Paul takes up these words (1 Corinthians 1:31); the verb "khoe" is kept so the quotation can be heard, while the wording is drawn from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: 자랑하는 자는 ... 자랑하여라
alternatives: | Paul draws on this verse in 1 Corinthians 1:31 and 2 Corinthians 10:17; Korean keeps the verb 자랑하다 at Literal and Balanced so the link can be seen.

decisions.choice: quem se gloria, que se glorie (L); quem quiser se orgulhar, que se orgulhe (B, R)
alternatives: quem se orgulha, que se orgulhe (B)
decisions.reason: Paul sums up this verse in 1 Corinthians 1:31 and 2 Corinthians 10:17 (m1), and each level takes the shape of 1 Corinthians 1:31's Portuguese at the same level ("Quem se gloria, deve se gloriar"; "Quem quiser se orgulhar, que se orgulhe"), with the subjunctive of command. Readable keeps "orgulhar-se" here, though it says "gabar-se" in verse 22, so that the link to Paul's words can be heard.

decisions.choice: amor leal (L, B), amor fiel (R); justiça; retidão
decisions.reason: The three words (m3) keep the terms set for the book: hesed "amor leal" / "amor fiel" (2:2), mishpat "justiça" and tsedaqah "retidão" (4:2; Isaiah 1:21).

decisions.choice: the New Testament wording of 1 Corinthians 1:31 and 2 Corinthians 10:17 kept: "የሚመካ ... ይመካ" (L), "የሚመካ ሁሉ ... ይመካ" (B), "መመካት የሚፈልግ ማንም ሰው ... ይመካ" (R)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in the Greek form "in the Lord"; the Hebrew has "in this", explained by what follows (knowing the LORD), so the Amharic keeps the New Testament's verbs and subject and follows the Hebrew with "በዚህ".

decisions.choice: loyal love "ጽኑ ፍቅር"; justice "ፍርድ" (L), "ፍትሕ" (B, R); righteousness "ጽድቅ"
decisions.reason: As the terms list for ḥesed, mishpat and tsedaqah.

decisions.choice: "जो गर्व करे, वह इस बात पर गर्व करे" (L); "जो गर्व करे, वह इस विषय में गर्व करे" (B); "जो कोई गर्व करना चाहे, वह इस बात के विषय में गर्व करे" (R)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in 1 Corinthians 1:31 and 2 Corinthians 10:17. Each level keeps the wording those verses have in this translation at the same level, changing only what the Hebrew has: "in this", where Paul has "in the Lord".

decisions.choice: "अटल प्रेम" at Readable too
decisions.reason: God's hesed is "अटल प्रेम" at every level, as in Psalms and Lamentations; Hindi needs no plainer form at Readable.

decisions.choice: "хвалящийся пусть хвалится" (L); "кто хвалится, пусть хвалится" (B); "кто хочет хвалиться, пусть хвалится" (R)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in 1 Corinthians 1:31 and 2 Corinthians 10:17; each level keeps the wording of those verses in this translation. Where Paul says "в Господе / Господом", the Hebrew says "in this", spelled out as knowing the LORD, so the object follows the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "неизменная любовь"
decisions.reason: God's hesed is "неизменная любовь" at every level, as the poetry note settles.

decisions.choice: yithallel hammithallel "誇る者は、このことを誇れ" (L), "…誇りなさい" (B), "誇りたい人は、このことを誇りなさい" (R): drafted from the Hebrew, close to Paul's quotation in 2 Corinthians 10:17 ("誇る者は主を誇りなさい" B; "誇りたい人は" R), which gives the sense in his own words (m1).
decisions.reason: The echo is kept where the Hebrew allows; the object here is "this", not "the Lord".

decisions.choice: chesed of God "誠実" (L), "変わらぬいつくしみ" (B), "変わらない愛" (R), as the JER table; mishpat "公正", tsedaqah "正義" at every level.
decisions.reason: JER conventions.

ko.L: 보아라, 날들이 온다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그때에 내가 포피에 할례를 받은 모든 자를 벌하겠다.

ko.R: 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에 나는 몸으로만 할례를 받은 모든 사람을 벌하겠다.

hi.L: देखो, ऐसे दिन आ रहे हैं, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, जब मैं उन सब को दंड दूँगा जिनका ख़तना खलड़ी में हुआ है,

ru.L: Вот, приходят дни, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} взыщу со всех обрезанных в крайней плоти:

ja.L: 見なさい、日々が来る――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。そのとき、わたしは、割礼を受けていても包皮のままの者を、みな罰する。
ja.B: その日が来る、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。そのとき、わたしは、割礼を受けていながら割礼のない者と変わらない者たちを、みな罰する。
ja.R: その時が来る、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。そのとき、わたしは、体にだけ割礼を受けている者を、みな罰する。

decisions.choice: circumcised in the foreskin: circumcised yet uncircumcised, the outward sign without the reality
decisions.reason: The phrase is a paradox: people who are circumcised and yet still "in foreskin". Verse 25 explains it: the nations are uncircumcised and Israel is uncircumcised in heart, so the outward mark does not protect anyone. The phrase can also be taken as "circumcised and uncircumcised alike", meaning everyone without exception; verse 25 favors the first reading.

decisions.choice: days are coming: a time the LORD will bring
decisions.reason: This formula announces a future act of God, whether of judgment (7:32; 19:6) or of restoration (16:14; 23:5; 31:31).

decisions.choice: punish: visit in judgment
decisions.reason: The verb means to visit, to come and deal with someone; with "on" it means to bring punishment (verse 8).

decisions.choice: circumcised only in body
decisions.reason: Readable puts the paradox in plain words: the people have the mark of circumcision on their bodies, but nothing more (meaning decision m1). Readable ends the sentence here and repeats "I will punish" in verse 25.

decisions.choice: the list of verse 25 joined to this verse's object (자를 벌하겠다), with verse 25 naming them
alternatives: | Korean closes verse 24 as a sentence and lets verse 25 name the nations under the same verb, so each verse keeps its own words.

decisions.choice: the verb "I will punish" closes this verse, so that verse 25 can stand as the list of those punished
alternatives: a relative clause "የምቀጣበት" continued into verse 25

records.literal_gloss: on Egypt and on Judah and on Edom and on [the] sons of Ammon and on Moab and on all [those] clipped [at the] corner who dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations [are] uncircumcised, and all [the] house of Israel [are] uncircumcised of heart.

en.L: on Egypt, and on Judah, and on Edom, and on the {{gender:children|sons}} of Ammon, and on Moab, and on all who are clipped [at the] corners, who live in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.
en.B: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the Ammonites, Moab, and all who clip the hair at their temples and live in the desert. For every one of these nations is uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.
en.R: I will punish Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon and Moab. I will punish the desert tribes who cut their hair short at the sides. For all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the people of Israel are uncircumcised in heart: their hearts are closed to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: a Egipto, y a Judá, y a Edom, y a los hijos de Amón, y a Moab, y a todos los que se rapan [las] sienes, que habitan en el desierto; porque todas las naciones son incircuncisas, y toda la casa de Israel es incircuncisa de corazón.
es.B: a Egipto, a Judá, a Edom, a los amonitas, a Moab y a todos los que se rapan las sienes y viven en el desierto. Porque todas estas naciones son incircuncisas, y toda la casa de Israel es incircuncisa de corazón.
es.R: Castigaré a Egipto, a Judá, a Edom, a Amón y a Moab. Castigaré a las tribus del desierto que se cortan el pelo a los lados de la cabeza. Porque todas estas naciones son incircuncisas, y todo el pueblo de Israel es incircunciso de corazón: su corazón está cerrado para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: l’Égypte, et Juda, et Édom, et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Ammon, et Moab, et tous ceux qui se rasent les tempes, qui habitent dans le désert ; car toutes les nations sont incirconcises, et toute la maison d’Israël est incirconcise de cœur.
fr.B: l’Égypte, Juda, Édom, les Ammonites, Moab, et tous ceux qui se taillent les cheveux sur les tempes et habitent le désert. Car toutes ces nations sont incirconcises, et toute la maison d’Israël est incirconcise de cœur.
fr.R: Je punirai l’Égypte, Juda, Édom, Ammon et Moab. Je punirai les tribus du désert qui se coupent les cheveux sur les côtés de la tête. Car toutes ces nations sont incirconcises, et tout le peuple d’Israël est incirconcis de cœur : leur cœur {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}est fermé.

sw.L: juu ya Misri, na juu ya Yuda, na juu ya Edomu, na juu ya wana wa Amoni, na juu ya Moabu, na juu ya wote walionyoa [nywele za] pembeni, wakaao nyikani; kwa maana mataifa yote hawajatahiriwa, na nyumba yote ya Israeli hawajatahiriwa moyoni.
sw.B: Misri, Yuda, Edomu, Waamoni, Moabu, na wote wanaonyoa nywele za pembeni mwa vichwa vyao na kuishi jangwani. Kwa maana kila mmoja wa mataifa haya hajatahiriwa, na nyumba yote ya Israeli haijatahiriwa moyoni.
sw.R: Nitaiadhibu Misri, Yuda, Edomu, Amoni na Moabu. Nitayaadhibu makabila ya jangwani yanayokata nywele zao fupi pembeni. Kwa maana mataifa haya yote hayajatahiriwa, na watu wote wa Israeli hawajatahiriwa moyoni: mioyo yao imefungwa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.

vi.L: tức là Ai Cập, Giu-đa, Ê-đôm, con cái Am-môn, Mô-áp, và mọi kẻ cạo tóc hai bên thái dương, là những kẻ sống trong hoang mạc; vì mọi dân tộc đều không cắt bì, và cả nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên đều không cắt bì trong lòng.
vi.B: tức là Ai Cập, Giu-đa, Ê-đôm, người Am-môn, Mô-áp, và tất cả những kẻ cắt tóc hai bên thái dương sống trong sa mạc. Vì tất cả các dân tộc ấy đều không cắt bì, và cả nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên đều không cắt bì trong lòng.
vi.R: Ta sẽ trừng phạt Ai Cập, Giu-đa, Ê-đôm, Am-môn và Mô-áp. Ta sẽ trừng phạt các bộ tộc sa mạc cắt tóc ngắn hai bên đầu. Vì tất cả các dân tộc ấy đều không cắt bì, và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đều không cắt bì trong lòng: lòng chúng đóng kín đối với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 이집트와 유다와 에돔과 암몬 자손과 모압과 광야에 살면서 [머리] 옆을 깎은 모든 자를 [벌하겠다]. 모든 민족은 할례를 받지 않았고, 이스라엘 온 집은 마음에 할례를 받지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이집트와 유다와 에돔과 암몬 사람들과 모압과, 광야에 살면서 관자놀이의 머리털을 깎는 모든 사람을 벌하겠다. 이 모든 민족은 할례를 받지 않았고, 이스라엘 온 집은 마음에 할례를 받지 않았다.
ko.R: 나는 이집트와 유다와 에돔과 암몬과 모압을 벌하겠다. 머리 옆을 짧게 깎고 사막에 사는 부족들도 벌하겠다. 이 모든 민족은 할례를 받지 않았고, 이스라엘 백성은 모두 마음에 할례를 받지 않았다. 그들의 마음이 나에게 닫혀 있다.

pt.L: o Egito, e Judá, e Edom, e os filhos de Amom, e Moabe, e todos os que cortam [o cabelo] nos cantos, que habitam no deserto; pois todas as nações são incircuncisas, e toda a casa de Israel é incircuncisa de coração.
pt.B: o Egito, Judá, Edom, os amonitas, Moabe e todos os que cortam o cabelo nas têmporas e vivem no deserto. Pois todas essas nações são incircuncisas, e toda a casa de Israel é incircuncisa de coração.
pt.R: Vou castigar o Egito, Judá, Edom, Amom e Moabe. Vou castigar as tribos do deserto que cortam o cabelo curto dos lados. Pois todas essas nações são incircuncisas, e todo o povo de Israel é incircunciso de coração: o seu coração está fechado para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

am.L: ግብፅን፣ ይሁዳንም፣ ኤዶምንም፣ የአሞንንም ልጆች፣ ሞዓብንም፣ በምድረ በዳም የሚኖሩትን [የጠጉራቸው] ዳር የተቆረጠውን ሁሉ፤ ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ያልተገረዙ ናቸውና፤ የእስራኤልም ቤት ሁሉ በልብ ያልተገረዘ ነው።
am.B: ግብፅን፣ ይሁዳን፣ ኤዶምን፣ አሞናውያንን፣ ሞዓብንና የጠጉራቸውን ዳር እየተላጩ በምድረ በዳ የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ። እነዚህ ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ያልተገረዙ ናቸውና፤ የእስራኤልም ቤት ሁሉ በልቡ ያልተገረዘ ነው።
am.R: ግብፅን፣ ይሁዳን፣ ኤዶምን፣ አሞንንና ሞዓብን እቀጣለሁ። የጠጉራቸውን ዳር የሚላጩትን የበረሃ ነገዶችም እቀጣለሁ። እነዚህ ሕዝቦች ሁሉ ያልተገረዙ ናቸውና፤ የእስራኤልም ሕዝብ ሁሉ በልባቸው ያልተገረዙ ናቸው፤ ልባቸው ለእኔ ዝግ ነው።

hi.L: मिस्र को, और यहूदा को, और एदोम को, और {{gender:अम्मोन की सन्तान|अम्मोन के पुत्रों}} को, और मोआब को, और उन सब को जिनके [बाल] कोनों पर कटे हैं, जो निर्जन प्रदेश में रहते हैं; क्योंकि सब जातियाँ ख़तनारहित हैं, और इस्राएल का सारा घराना मन से ख़तनारहित है।
hi.B: मिस्र, यहूदा, एदोम, अम्मोनियों, मोआब, और उन सब को जो अपनी कनपटियों के बाल कटवाते हैं और रेगिस्तान में रहते हैं। क्योंकि ये सब देश ख़तनारहित हैं, और इस्राएल का सारा घराना मन से ख़तनारहित है।
hi.R: मैं मिस्र, यहूदा, एदोम, अम्मोन और मोआब को दंड दूँगा। मैं रेगिस्तान के उन क़बीलों को दंड दूँगा जो अपने सिर के किनारों के बाल छोटे कटवाते हैं। क्योंकि ये सब देश ख़तनारहित हैं, और इस्राएल के सब लोग मन से ख़तनारहित हैं: उनके मन मेरे लिए बंद हैं।

ru.L: с Египта, и с Иуды, и с Едома, и с {{gender:детей Аммона|сынов Аммона}}, и с Моава, и со всех остриженных [по] краям, живущих в пустыне; потому что все народы необрезаны, и весь дом Израиля необрезан сердцем.
ru.B: Египет, Иуду, Едом, аммонитян, Моав и всех, кто подстригает волосы на висках и живёт в пустыне. Ведь все эти народы необрезаны, а весь дом Израиля необрезан сердцем.
ru.R: Я накажу Египет, Иуду, Едом, Аммон и Моав. Я накажу кочевые племена пустыни, которые коротко стригут волосы по бокам головы. Ведь все эти народы необрезаны, и весь народ Израиля необрезан сердцем: их сердца закрыты для {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}.

ja.L: エジプト、ユダ、エドム、アンモンの子ら、モアブ、そして荒れ野に住む、こめかみを刈り込んだすべての者を。すべての国々は無割礼であり、イスラエルの家はみな心に割礼がないからだ。
ja.B: エジプト、ユダ、エドム、アンモン人、モアブ、そして、こめかみの髪を刈り込んで荒れ野に住むすべての者を。これらの国々はみな無割礼であり、イスラエルの家もみな、心に割礼を受けていないからだ。
ja.R: わたしは、エジプト、ユダ、エドム、アンモン、モアブを罰する。頭の横の髪を短く切っている荒れ野の部族も罰する。これらの国々はみな、割礼を受けていない。イスラエルの人々もみな、心に割礼を受けていない。彼らの心は、わたしに閉ざされている。

decisions.choice: Egypt, Edom, Ammon, Moab ... all the nations are uncircumcised: circumcision without covenant
decisions.reason: Circumcision was not only Israel's custom: the Egyptians practiced it, and some of Israel's neighbors seem to have done so too. To the LORD it means nothing in itself. Judah is listed among these nations, as one more people with the outward mark and no more.

decisions.choice: clipped at the corners: desert tribes who cut the hair at the sides of the head
alternatives: those who live in the far corners of the desert
decisions.reason: The phrase most likely describes the desert Arab tribes, who cut their hair short at the temples; Jeremiah uses it of them again in 25:23 and 49:32. Israel was told not to cut the hair at the sides of the head (Leviticus 19:27), perhaps because the custom was tied to other worship. The words could also mean "those who live in the far corners" of the desert; either way the same peoples are meant.

decisions.choice: uncircumcised in heart: a heart closed to the LORD
decisions.reason: The law speaks of an uncircumcised heart that must be humbled (Leviticus 26:41) and calls Israel to circumcise the foreskin of their hearts (Deuteronomy 10:16), a work the LORD himself promises to do (Deuteronomy 30:6). Jeremiah gave the same call (4:4). Israel, circumcised in body, is no better than the nations, because its heart is closed to God.

decisions.choice: the Ammonites; I will punish; their hearts are closed to me
decisions.reason: Balanced says "the Ammonites" for "the sons of Ammon". Readable repeats "I will punish" from verse 24 and explains "uncircumcised in heart" as Leviticus 26:41 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: hawajatahiriwa moyoni
decisions.reason: "Uncircumcised in heart" in the words of Deuteronomy 10:16, as at 4:4.

decisions.choice: "incirconcis de cœur"
decisions.reason: The wording of the call to circumcise the heart in 4:4 and Deuteronomy 10:16, kept at every level as the English keeps it.

decisions.choice: incircuncisa de coração
decisions.reason: The phrase takes up Leviticus 26:41 and Deuteronomy 10:16 (m3), as 4:4 does; every level keeps "incircunciso" with "de coração", and Readable explains it with the words of 4:4 and Deuteronomy 10:16 ("fechado", "abram"). Edom, Ammon and Moab take their usual Portuguese forms, "Edom", "Amom", "Moabe".

decisions.reason: As the history books and the sons of Israel: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase under the gender setting, Balanced names the people.
